integrity: An exact resolvent identity and boundary-uniform estimates prove the sharp global asymptotics; independent finite-dimensional numerical checks corroborate the formulas but are not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The separation k is held fixed while d grows; homogeneous Poisson resets always return to the initial non-target vertex, and no optimality over other restart policies is claimed. Historical priority remains subject to independent scrutiny.
title: Sharp Poisson-reset search on a high-dimensional hypercube
